stage1.impression: A clean, likeable idea: eight tinted horn speakers in spectrum order on white paper, each throwing a coloured patch of light forward. But it reads as a tidy CG range shot, not a photograph. The floor is a blank, cool, grainless white, the body shadows are flat grey slabs, the coloured light is pale and pushed far from the speakers, the smoked unit is a black hole, and the staggered line reads as jitter rather than an arc.

blocking_9: The coloured light reads as the subject: dense, saturated patches close to each speaker, and body shadows deep enough that the colour pops against them (shadow lum about 100-120, not 134-145)
The paper reads as real paper: visible tooth and mottle in the foreground, warm-neutral rather than blue (delta E2000 to #EEECE7 under 4)
The arrangement reads at a glance as one deliberate arc, not as a jittered line of uneven heights
The smoked speaker shows its form (edges, ring, horn mouth) instead of a near-black silhouette
No shadow is cut by the frame edge, and the frame is balanced left to right
The background wall is bright and airy behind the title, without a grey band at the cove

defects.what: Foreground paper is a flat, featureless field (lum range 1.7), no tooth or grain: reads as CG
Paper has a blue cast (RGB 236/237/247) against a 5200 K sun; delta E2000 7.45 to the specified #EEECE7
Body shadows are lifted flat grey (lum 134, cool), so the coloured patches have little to read against
Coloured patches are pale (red reads pink: G 171, B 182) and land 0.5-1 m away from their speakers, separated from them by grey shadow
The red speaker's shadow and colour patch run out of the frame's left edge
Two staggered ranks make the feet sit at alternating heights (y about 400 vs 430): the line reads as uneven, not as an arc
Smoked speaker is a near-black block (lum median 27, crush 1.1 %); its shadow is the same neutral grey as the clear one's
A grey band at the cove: wall at about 203-207 meets floor at 235, a soft horizon seam
Wall is a dull mid-grey (median 211), duller than the floor; the top of a homepage hero looks overcast
Cabinets carry hard dark outlines and studio-clean, uniform highlights; little sense of the scene's back light glowing through their edges

changes.problem: The coloured light, the picture's whole idea, is pale because the fill from above lifts the shadows and washes out the patches.

evidence.measured: body shadow lum median 133.7 (RGB 128/134/149); red patch [10,515,120,545] RGB 233/171/182, a pale pink

changes.expected: Grey body shadows fall to lum about 100-120 and the patches gain density and saturation; the red patch reads red rather than pink

changes.problem: The sun is so low that shadows run to the frame bottom and out of the left edge, and each colour patch lands far from its speaker.

evidence.measured: left edge lum p5 179.5 with R 235 / G 215: the red shadow and patch cross the frame edge

changes.expected: Shadows shorten by about a third; patches sit closer under each speaker, denser, and the red shadow stays inside the frame

changes.problem: The foreground paper has no texture at all, the clearest sign of a render.
changes.expected: A fine, visible paper grain in the foreground that fades with distance, with no tiling

changes.problem: The paper renders blue, which cools the whole frame against a warm sun and makes the white read as digital.
changes.expected: The paper reads warm-neutral, close to its specified colour; the grey shadows lose their blue

changes.problem: The two staggered ranks make the feet step up and down, so the line reads as careless jitter, not as one deliberate arc.

evidence.measured: seen: feet alternate between about y 400 (back rank) and y 430 (front rank)

change.from: alternate speakers 0.7 m farther back; arc depth 0.5 m; centres 0.72 m apart
change.to: a single rank, 0 m stagger; arc depth 1.4 m; centres 0.66 m apart; keep the hand-set turns

changes.expected: The eight read as one smooth arc whose feet trace a clean curve, the middle speakers slightly smaller, with clear floor between their coloured patches

changes.problem: The smoked speaker drops out as a black block and loses its form, a hole at the end of the line.

change.to: 80 W/m2, moved to [4.0, 0.5, 2.0] so it also rims the horn's top edge

changes.expected: The smoked cabinet's edges, ring and horn mouth separate from its body; it stays the darkest speaker but shows form

changes.problem: The wall is a dull grey and the cove shows a darker band, so the top of the hero, where the title sits, looks overcast and has a horizon seam.

evidence.measured: title zone lum median 213.6; profile at x 1180-1270 shows 203.6 at the cove, then 235 on the floor

change.to: 21 W/m2, centred 2.0 m up so it fills the cove

changes.expected: The wall rises to about 222-230, close to the floor's brightness, with an invisible cove; the title area stays even (range under 12)

out_of_scope.request: Soften the hard dark outlines on the cabinets' edges and make the internal ribs and linings read less like a diagram
out_of_scope.why: These are the speaker's own parts and materials, which are fixed

out_of_scope.request: Let the cabinets' bodies throw coloured light, not only the horns
out_of_scope.why: The opaque batts lining the cabinets set this; changing it would change the product
